name: gi-global-minimum-tax
description: Prepare Gibraltar global minimum-tax scope, domestic top-up and compliance working papers under the Global Minimum Tax Act 2024, checked in October 2026. Covers commencement, wholly domestic groups, separate calculation pools, covered-tax exclusions, information returns, exchange notifications, payment, records and selected penalties. Use for Pillar Two, domestic minimum top-up tax and income inclusion rule questions. This source-cited draft does not implement the complete GloBE income, deferred-tax, substance exclusion or safe-harbour calculations. Establish those inputs separately, retain the applicable source versions and obtain independent source and qualified professional review before filing, paying or claiming an exemption.
